title: Soul Feast #30: Everything is an Opportunity
excerpt: In this Soul Feast, Gary invites listeners to look beyond the surface of life’s events—both joyful and painful—and recognize that everything we encounter is an opportunity for spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast, Gary invites listeners to look beyond the surface of life’s events—both joyful and painful—and recognize that everything we encounter is an opportunity for spiritual growth. 

Whether it’s a burst of inspiration, a moment of frustration, or an intense emotional experience, each instance is an opening to become more emotionally aware and to choose with intention.

Gary explains that we are constantly creating consequences through our choices, whether we realize it or not. 

Most people live in reaction to fear, unconsciously reinforcing painful patterns.

But when we become aware of the frightened parts of our personality—and consciously choose love instead—we begin to create authentic power. 

That’s the essence of our evolution as multi-sensory beings in the Earth School: learning to choose love again and again.

The key to transformation lies in choosing with awareness. 

When you infuse your intentions with love rather than fear, you shift the trajectory of your life—one choice at a time.

Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:40) — What “opportunity” really means in a spiritual context—and what it doesn’t mean
  • (02:17) — How every moment, even the painful ones, is a chance to choose love over fear
  • (05:56) — Why unconscious intentions create unintended consequences—and how to change that
  • (10:15) — The spiritual power of emotional awareness and separating yourself from fear-driven reactions
  • (14:35) — A multi-sensory view of the Golden Rule—and how intention transforms everything
  • (17:00) — Why your spiritual teachers aren’t concerned with your job, relationship, or finances—and what they are focused on

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Look at your day—this morning, this evening, this very moment. What is being activated in you? Is it fear, frustration, or judgment? Or is it love, compassion, and presence? Pause and reflect: What intention are you bringing into your experiences right now? This week, practice noticing when a frightened part of your personality is active, and instead of reacting, consciously choose to act from love. Let every moment become your spiritual classroom.

Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Enroll in Soul Themes Today. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey!
